Why this exists

Practitioners kept getting quoted agency prices for template work.

A nurse practitioner opening her own clinic does not need a twelve-week discovery process and a retainer. She needs a site that loads fast, states her credentials clearly, takes bookings, and does not look like the four other clinics in her city that bought the same theme.

That is a week of focused work, not a quarter of meetings. So ZmaxLab is priced and scheduled like a week of focused work.

The trade-off is honest: I am one person, so I take a limited number of builds. What you get in return is that the person you speak to is the person who builds it.
